# ---------------- 4. BICYCLE: WHEELS ---------------- def generate_spokes(cx, cy, r_inner=14, r_outer=72, count=28): spokes = [] for i in range(count): angle = i * (2 * math.pi / count) a_inner = angle + 0.15 * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1) x1 = cx + r_inner * math.cos(a_inner) y1 = cy + r_inner * math.sin(a_inner) x2 = cx + r_outer * math.cos(angle) y2 = cy + r_outer * math.sin(angle) spokes.append(f'') return "\n ".join(spokes)
rear_spokes = generate_spokes(230, 475) front_spokes = generate_spokes(680, 475)
svg.append(f'''
{rear_spokes}
{front_spokes}
''')
